data.one_liner: Wraps Server‑Sent Events as a StreamChannel for Dart IO and web
data.what_it_does: Provides a spec‑aligned SSE client that exposes events as MessageEvent objects and a unified StreamChannel API. It handles reconnection, retry hints, and Last‑Event‑ID automatically.
use_when: You need to consume an SSE endpoint in a Flutter or Dart app
You want event metadata (id, event name) in addition to payload
You need a testable, mockable SSE client
You prefer a single API for both VM and web platforms
avoid_when: You only need simple HTTP requests or WebSocket communication
Your server uses a different push protocol (e.g., MQTT, gRPC)
strengths: Spec‑compliant IO implementation with automatic reconnection
Unified StreamChannel API for both VM and web
Built‑in test support via HtmlSseChannel.test and injectable IO channel
Rich event objects with data, event name, and id
weaknesses: Only supports SSE, not other push protocols
